run_update_data: run the script to update dataset files in a folder with fixed value transformations
run_check_fixed_value: run check_fixed_value on a dictionary to detect if it contains string fields needing update
run_updated_fixed_value: run updated_fixed_value on a dictionary to transform string fields into fixed_value wrapper dicts
run_update_yaw_pitch_span: run update_yaw_pitch_span on a dictionary to extract yaw_span or pitch_span values
run_check_yaw_pitch_span: run check_yaw_pitch_span on a dictionary to detect if it contains yaw or pitch span entries
